title: Every step of superviseRun that can throw still ends in finalize
description: Absorbed from yoh finding 5882bf18 (4lv). 4lv made a boot step that exhausts its retries reach finalize. superviseRun's context and progress steps can still throw past finalize the same way, leaving tokens unrevoked, the run row unsettled and containers unswept. The Workflow's job after yoh is boot, budget, watch, retry, FINALIZE, so every throwing step must reach it.
